87)༄༅/snga 'gyur bka' ma'i drag dmar 'o bran lugs kyi brgyud 'debs ni/88)༄༅/khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /'phags mchog snying rje

tei:div.tei:p: 87)༄༅/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i drag dmar 'o bran lugs kyi brgyud 'debs ni/ 88)༄༅/ khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur// 'phags mchog snying rje'i dbang phyug mig mi 'dzum// rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// 'phags bzhi bskyed yum dbyings phyug mkhar chen bza'/ grub pa'i dbang phyug 'o bran dpal 'byung dang*// 'byung bzhir dbang sgyur 'o bran dbang phyug la// gsol ba 'debs so= thogs med mthu mnga' 'o bran chos 'byung dang*// drag rtsal nus thob 'o bran grags pa'i mtshan// 'khor 'das dbang sgyur 'o bran dbang rgyal la// gsol ba= gsang chen 89) mdzod brnyes 'o bran rta mchog rgyal// lta dgongs gdeng ldan 'o bran ri rab brtan// nyi ma rgyal mtshan kun dga' blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs= rin chen chos rgyal tshul khrims dbang phyug dang*// dkon mchog gsum 'bangs dbang phyug rdo rje'i mtshan// gtsug lag rgya mtsho karma lung rigs la// gsol ba= snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma gter bdag gling*// theg mchog bstan 'dzin kun bzang rnam par rgyal// gsang sngags bstan 'dzin mthu stobs rnam rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so= mdzod lnga'i shing rta blo gros pha mtha' yas// thub bstan nyin byed rgyal mtshan 'od 90)zer zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyid pal che// che ba'i che mchog pad+ma drag po rtsal// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgyud gsum srung ma la// gsol ba= dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig rnam par dag /bskyed rdzogs don la rang byan tshud pa dang*// mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin 'grub nas kyang*// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun bzang sar 'god shog/

ces pa'ang pad+ma ma ṇis so// ༄/ drag dmar 'o bran lugs kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/ oṃ swas+t+wi/ chos nyid zhi las g.yo med kyang*// drag gtum dregs pa'i gnyan po ru// cher khros dbang drag lhag pa'i lhar// btud nas sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad// 'dir drag dmar 'o bran lugs su grags pa'i sgrub thabs la gsum/ sbyor dngos rjes so/ sbyor ba'i chos la drug gi dang po ni/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor tshogs mchod tsam la/ sman rag gtor gsum/ nyer spyod sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bsham mo/ gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ ho: sku gsum lha tshogs nam mkha' khyab 91)pa la: phyag 'tshal gus mchod sdig bshags yi rang 'bul: ka dag chos dbyings klong du skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sgrol phyir rdo rje'i sems bskyed do: zhes lan gsum/ spro na/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: sogs kyang bya'o/ gsum pa bgegs skrod pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon gcig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang zhing: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod rnamasaḥ mchod sbyin bzang pos tshim byos la: myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: sprul pa'i khro tshogs mang po yis: rdul du rlog par gdon mi za: drag sngags brjod la bskrad/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni ye nas rang byung ba'i: sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor los sgyur: che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal: thugs las khro chung mtshon cha dang: rab 'bar me yi tsha tsha 'phro: phyogs mtshams kun tu rab tu gtams: bar chad kun gyis mi phyed pa'i: gzhom med 92)rdo rje'i gur du gyur: badz+ra kro dha tsakra rak+sha dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ bh+rum̐: lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku 'jigs byaid khro bo'i skur ston pa: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes brtser dgongs la:

'dir gshegs dbang bskur byin phob dngos grub stsol: ngo mtshar rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston: badz+ra gu ru kro dha ra dza sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ drug pa mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= nas/ shab+da sarba pañca a mri ta rak+ta ba ling+ta āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun gyi dang po lha bskyed pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa las/ hūm̐: rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur bla bre 'khrigs: ye shes me ri kha dog sna lnga 'bar: phyi rol gser 'khor me 'khor rtsibs 93)stong 'bar: rtsibs stong sprul pa'i pho nya lcags sdig 'gyed: dbus su 'byung bzhi ri rab pad+ma'i steng: sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs drag po'i rgyan gyis spras: rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo'i lte bar chos 'byung dbus: rdo rje hūm̐ yig 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du las: khro rgyal pad+ma drag po he ru ka: me dpung ltar dmar khros 'khrugs rngam pa'i gzugs: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkhar 'phyar: phyag g.yon thugs sprul lcags sdig nag po ni: mig dgu bsgrad cing kha dgus dgra bgegs za: bco brgyad rwa yis gdon bgegs snying nas 'dzin: yang sprul nying sprul stong gsum 'gengs pa 'dzin: thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon do shal 'phyang: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum dmar zlum bgrad: dbu skra sma ra smin ma me bzhin 'bar: dpal gyi chas brgyad gar gyi nyams dgu ldan: pad na yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngo: gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud cing 94) gnyis med sbyor: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje mthon mthing mdog: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdig 'dzub mdzad: gser gyi mchod rten bum par sku brten bzhugs: gtso bo'i spyi bor pad+ma saṃ bha wa:

mthing ga rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wam̐ bsnams: 'dzum zhal mdzes ldan za 'og ber chen gsol: sha'u'i snyan zhu rgod ldem rtse sgros brgyan: spyi bo'i gtsug na sprul pa'i mkha' lding ni: spu gri'i bde gshog 'bar ba g.yob cing rdeb: phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs la rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ni: dkar ser dmar ljang gri thod kha ṭām̐ 'dzin: gar stabs kyis 'gying bde ba'i ro yis gang: mtshams bzhir bcud ldan rin chen bum pas brgyan: shar sgor gsang bdag phyag rdor sngon po ni: rdo rje 'phyar zhing sdig 'dzub drag por sgreng: lho sgor 'jam dpal gshin rje sku mdog ser: g.yas pa ral gri g.yon pa sdig 'dzub can: nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po rta skad 'tsher: dbyug to 'phyar zhing sdig 'dzub me chen 'bar: 95) byang sgor yak+sha me dbal mthing nag brjid: tho chen 'phyar zhing lcags kyu me 'bar gdeng: kun kyang rngam brjid dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung sku las 'bar: lha tshogs kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bos mtshan par gyur: zhes pas gsal gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs par bsam la/ ham̐'u: rnga yab gling dang o rgyan yul: zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas: pad+ma drag po 'khor bcas rnams: spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: zhes dang tshig bdun gsol 'debs kyang brjod pa'i mthar/ e h+ya hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥpheṃ pheṃ hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ: zhes pas spyan drangs/ dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dgug gzhug bcing gsum byas te dam ye dbyer med du bsam mo/ gsum pa ni/ ho: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs kyis: phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas: yon tan kun rdzogs 'od dpag med: 'khor la gtso bos rgyas btab 96) po: zhes pas dbang bskur/ bzhi pa ni/ ho: me tog la sogs phyi mchod rdzas: 'dod yon lnga po nang gi rdzas:

gnyis med 'khril sbyor gsang ba'i rdzas: bdud rtsi lnga po dam tshig rdzas: sha lnga la sogs gtor ma'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman: 'dod chags dag pa rak+ta'i mtsho: spros bral ka dag don dam ste: mchod sprin rab 'byams gcig bsdus pas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad mchod: ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta'i bar dang*/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā ba litaṃ khā hi: zhes pas mchod/ lnga pa ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi drag po'i sku: nus pa thogs med log 'dren 'dzoms: thugs rje rmad byung dkyil 'khor gtso: pad+ma thod phreng drag por 'dud: zhes pa tsam mam spro na bstod pa gzhan yang*/ chos kyi dbyings las longs spyod rdzogs skur shar: bdud 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum bdag nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso: mkha' ltar kun khyab khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnyis med yum 97) mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro gsang bdag gshin rje dang: rta mgrin me dbal la sogs grangs med 'khor: chu zla'i rol pa ston la phyag 'tshal bstod: drug pa ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags kyis bskor: de las 'od 'phros stong gsum gang: bgegs bcom rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus: rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i bdag nyid nga'o: oṃ ā:hūm̐ artsika ne rtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: snying po'o/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya badz+ra ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa: rā dza gnod byed kyi snying la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gtso bo'i 'o/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni hūm̐ phaṭa: de bzhin du/ bud+dha: rat+na: pad+ma: karma:mkha' 'gro lnga'i 'o/ badz+ra pa ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa: yoṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pad+man+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra yak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa: 'khor sngags so/ gco bo'i thugs ka'i phyag rdor gyi/ thugs srog hūm̐ yig rab tu 'bar// hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra cher sgrog pas: /hūm̐ gi sprin gyis phyogs kun khyab/

hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes hūm̐ sgrub ste rim pa bzhin ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar 98) mchod bstod nas/ bdun pa 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsalaḥ glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rdzes rtser dgongs la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang skur byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: kā ya wāka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la ho: zhes dngos grub blang ngo/ gsum pa las/ dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa la drug gi dang po ni/ hūm̐: thugs las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas: ma dag nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs: bh+rum̐ las rin chen snod nang du: tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: rigs lnga'i dam rdzas 'dod yon rdzas: zag med nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ a:hūm̐ ho: zhes byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐: o rgyan gling dang rnga yab gling: laṅka dpal gyi pho brang nas: che mchog pad+ma drag po'i tshogs: spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa spyan drangs/ gsum pa tshogs mchod ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: gus pa'i 99) blo yis 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhes su gsol: ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi: bzhi pa bar bshags ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: sgo gsum mi shes bag med pas: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi: zhes dang yig brgya bzla/ lnga pa bsgral bstab ni: hūm̐: che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gtum drag rngam pa'i rang bzhin la: yak+sha me dbal skar ltar 'khrug: las byed pho nya bcas pa rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la babs: zhing bcu'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi: gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du shigs: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor: nṛ tri sha trum̐ mā ra ya rbad: zhes bsgral cing bstab la/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: don snying nang rol bcas pa rnams: ye shes bdur rtsir byin rlabs nas:

bzhes shig rol cig dgyes par mdzod: maṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha hi: tshogs la rol zhing/ drug pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: 100) sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam bcas bzhin: dkyil 'khor chen po phyi nyul ba'i: lhag gto+er dbang ba'i srung ma rnams: 'di bzhes bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta khā hi: gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: dbang drag 'bar ba dpal gyi pho nyar bcas: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs: snyigs dus gdug can dgra bgegs 'byung po'i dpung: bod khams phung byed sde dang bcas pa rnams: rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs nus pas tshar gcod la: yang dag lam gyi bde chen rgyas par mdzod: gsum pa chad tho ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis: dam la btags pa'i srung ma rnams: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal khams su: lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags: bdag ni slob dpon de yi brgyud: khyod ni lha 'dre g.yar dam can: sngon tshe khas blangs bca' ma bcag: da lta rig 'dzin dam ma 'dral: 101)rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: bzhi pa brtan ma ni/ bh+yo: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi: bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma longs: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: lnga pa bro mnan ni/ hūm̐: nga ni 'jigs byed chen po ste: khams gsum srid gsum spyi nas gnon: dgra bgegs sdig chen 'byung po rnams: dug gsum las kyi khung bur mnan: mnan no bcings so stam+bha ya: rdo rje bro yis rgyas gdab bo: sus kyang 'jig par nus ma yin: oṃ laṃ ā:laṃ hūm̐ laṃ stam+bha ya nan: drug pa rjes chog la lnga las/ dang po nongs pa bshags pa ni/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod la/ ma rnyed yongs su tshang dang sogs dang yig brgya brjod/ gnyis pa brtan bzhugs ni/

'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu sogs brjod/ gsum pa sprul pa bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: chos nyid skye ba med pa las: 'gag med rdo rje srin por shar: 'gag pa nyid nas 'gag med pa: spros bral ka dag klong 102)du thim: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor thams cad 'od gsal du bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ gyis thun mtshams kyi lhar snang ldang ngo: bzhi pa bsngo smon ni/ dge 'dis mtha' yas sems ni kun: khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po yi: go 'phang byang chub myur thob nas: bdud la rnam par rgyal ba shog: lnga pa shis brjod ni/ oṃ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs brgya'i bdag: bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dngos grub char 'bebs zhi dang khro'i: yi dam lha tshogs= thogs med phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: dpa' bo mkha' 'grau'i= gang la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub: dge legs mchog gi bkris shog: ces brjod do/ drag dmar bka' ma 'o bran lugs kyi gzhung snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang las 'byung ba gzhir bzhag gter chen nyid kyi zab gter drag dmar gyi rdo rje'i tshig gis zhal bskang te bklags pas grub pa shī la bha dra'i zhal 'don du pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// 103) rdo rje grod lod kyi brgyud 'debs ni/ khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// ye shes sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rdo rje sems// rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul dga' rab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// mkhyen rab sprul pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// blo mchog mnga' ba shri sengha'i zhabs// dngos grub mchog brnyes dz+nya na su tra la// gsol ba= mkhas grub chen po bi ma la mi tra// rang byung chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa// tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs rje 'bangs grogs gsum la// gsol ba= 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig klong chen pa// sde gsum klong dgu'i rgyan gcig 'jigs med gling*// thub bstan yongs rjogs rgyan gcig ngag gi dbang*// gsol ba=

bla ma spyi 'dus rdo rje gro bo lod// yi dam yongs 'dus dbang chen rta mchog dpal// mkha' 'gro kun 'dus pad+ma gzi ldan la// gsol ba= ye shes klong dgu rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 104)ging*// rang mdangs ma 'gags rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha// rig rtsal rang grol dam can chos skyong la// gsol ba= rdo rje'i gter srung che ge'i rgyud smin cing*// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig srog rtsa brtan// bskyed bzlas mthar phyin nus pa'i gding chen thob// rdzogs pas phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog 'grub shog/ srung ba'i rdzong brtan bzlog pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs// bsad pa'i mtshon chas lus sems kha sbyor dbye// mnan bsregs 'phang pas dgra bgegs tshar bcad de// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mthu thob shog rta skad thengs gsum gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi la// brten nas rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i lam bsgrod de// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog/
ces pa'ang ma hā shrī saṅgaso//
